c018.title: Happy hour
c018.story: After a long week, Max's new colleagues invite him to [[happy hour]]. They meet at a small [[bar]], and Anna comes too. The young [[bartender]] is fast, and the old [[barman]] only pours beer. The young man makes [[cocktails|cocktail]] for everyone. Oleh orders a [[martini]], and Iryna gets a [[margarita]] with salt. Taras tries a shot of [[tequila]] with lime. Max asks for a [[gin]] and [[tonic]]. Their boss drinks a [[lite]] beer. At the next table, an old man orders [[whiskey]] and then [[bourbon]]. One of his friends has a [[brandy]], and the other has a [[cognac]]. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she orders orange juice. By the end of the evening, Max knows everyone's name.

c019.title: Quiz night at the pub
c019.story: Every Thursday there is a [[quiz]] at an Irish [[pub]] in town. Anna, Max and their friends make a team. The barman brings dark [[ale]] and sweet [[cider]]. Max orders a cold [[lager]] from a new [[keg]]. Anna drinks tea and answers all the history questions. Between rounds, they play [[darts]]. Max misses the board every time. Then he plays [[snooker]] and wins easily. At the end, their team gets second place and a free pizza.

c020.title: A new sweater
c020.story: Today Anna goes [[shopping]] at a big [[shopping center]]. She needs a warm [[sweater]] for winter. Her British friend Emma calls it a [[jumper]]. A [[mannequin]] in a window wears a red one. Next to it are a [[cardigan]] and a [[hoodie]]. Everything is on [[sale]]! Anna wants [[cotton]], not [[nylon]] or [[polyester]]. She gets a student [[discount]] and uses a [[coupon]]. Her mom's gift [[voucher]] pays for half. She pays the rest in [[cash]]. Later, the shop sends her a small [[rebate]]. Now her new blue sweater is almost free!

c024.title: Anna's student budget
c024.story: Today Anna counts her money. Her parents send her a hundred [[dollars|dollar]]. She has 50 more: 100 [[plus]] 50 is 150. Books cost 40, and 150 [[minus]] 40 is 110. Anna is on a tight [[budget]]. She saves every [[cent]] in a jar. A [[penny]] is one cent. A [[dime]] is ten cents. On Monday she goes to the [[bank]]. She checks her [[balance]] and makes a [[deposit]]. Anna wants a new phone, but not on [[credit]]. She saves for it instead.

c026.title: Sofia's first fashion show
c026.story: Max's sister Sofia is studying to be a [[fashion designer]]. On Saturday she shows her first collection at a small [[fashion show]] in Kyiv. It isn't real [[couture]], but every piece is made by hand. A tall [[supermodel]] opens the show in a black [[corset]] and a long red cape. Next come soft jackets in [[cashmere]], [[tweed]] and [[flannel]]. The last man, dressed like a [[dandy]], wears a smart suit in [[khaki]]. After the show, a shop owner asks about the tweed jacket. "Every [[model]] in my collection comes in three colors," Sofia says proudly. Later, Anna asks her why she never uses nylon or polyester. "Natural [[material]] like wool feels better on the skin," Sofia says. "And good [[textiles|textile]] last for years." Her teacher says it is the best collection in the class.
